utts: Lao Wang, you absolutely must come to Sunday's event, I've already sworn to everyone you'll be there; don't you dare bail on us.
I genuinely can't swing it this time; I've got to take my mom to her doctor's appointment, it's all set in stone.
How am I supposed to handle this if you skip out? The whole crew has swapped shifts and is counting on you; for someone usually so dependable, this is a real letdown.
It's a bit of a bind with such last-minute notice, couldn't you show a little understanding?
This whole setup is tailored for you; skip it and the event collapses, talk about squandering everything.
Sigh, fine, I'll see if I can duck out briefly to pop by.
That's the spirit! And rope in a few extra hands while you're at it to keep things lively.
Hey, could you share that post for me on your Moments?
Just not feeling like sharing that kind of stuff lately. Handle it yourself.
Seriously? You won't even help with such a small thing? How stingy!
Who are you to tell me? Ask someone else if you want.
Ungrateful wretch! All my past kindness to you was wasted!
Are you insane? Who wants your phony kindness anyway?
Fine then. Don't expect any help from me at work going forward.
I'm moving next Saturday and I absolutely can't handle it alone - you've got to come help.
Sorry, I've got plans with an old classmate that day, probably can't make it.
When you moved last time, I came to help without hesitation.
How about I help you pack beforehand?
A move without a crowd just feels wrong - you had people over for your move too, didn't you?
Might only be able to stay briefly.
Whenever I remember us teaming up for that last move, it warms my heart.
Fine, I'll try to swing by and lend a hand.
How's that report coming along? If we keep dragging this out, the whole team's gonna suffer.
Ugh, it's brutal. Can't find all the research materials, progress is crawling.
Other teams submitted ages ago. They pulled all-nighters for the group - we can't be dead weights, right?
Nobody wants to hold things up... but this is seriously tricky...
I'll get Xiao Zhang to pitch in. Everyone's watching us now - gotta wrap this up properly.
Fine, I'll grind it out tonight and won't screw up the timeline.
Hey, you're taking leave next week? Nonsense! Can't you see what state the project is in? Get back to work immediately!
Boss, I've completed all the procedures, and family arrangements are set. I've even finished my tasks ahead of schedule.
Bullshit! Who'll handle your workload? New requirements are piling up like shit! You're just ditching responsibilities, zero sense of duty!
I've handed everything over in advance. And per company policy, I'm entitled to this annual leave.
Screw the rules! This is an emergency! Cut the crap, you damn well better be at your desk Monday! Mess this up and you'll be fucking responsible!
...Got it. I'll be back.
My birthday's tomorrow and I suddenly wanted to catch a movie, but too bad all tickets are sold out.
Huh? I actually have dinner plans with friends...
No worries, you guys enjoying yourselves is what matters most. I'm used to being alone anyway.
Maybe I can meet you after dinner?
No need to trouble yourself. After all, every year I just end up celebrating birthdays alone with cake.
Don't say that, I'll wrap things up quickly and come keep you company.
Really, don't force it. I'll be perfectly happy just seeing your cheerful dinner photos.
I insist on accompanying you. I'll cancel my plans right now.
